units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|name|17|0
units.english: Assist Predecessor Research
units.italian: Assisti la ricerca sui Predecessori

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|description|18|0
units.english: Transport these <bunks> scholars researching the Predecessors to <planet stopovers> and back home to <destination> by <date>.
units.italian: Trasporta questi <bunks> studiosi che indagano sui Predecessori fino a <planet stopovers> e poi a casa, su <destination>, entro il <date>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|As you land on the spaceport pad, you see a familiar face approaching; it is Sieasej, the Successor scholar who translated for you during your first contact with the Successors and assisted you during your mission for House Sioeora. They are moving towards you with a small group of similarly-dressed individuals, whom you assume are also scholars of some sort.|34|0
units.english: As you land on the spaceport pad, you see a familiar face approaching; it is Sieasej, the Successor scholar who translated for you during your first contact with the Successors and assisted you during your mission for House Sioeora. They are moving towards you with a small group of similarly-dressed individuals, whom you assume are also scholars of some sort.
units.italian: Mentre atterri sulla piazzola dello spazioporto, vedi avvicinarsi un volto noto: è Sieasej, lo studioso Successore che ti ha fatto da traduttore durante il tuo primo contatto con i Successori e ti ha assistito nella missione per Casa Sioeora. Si stanno muovendo verso di te con un piccolo gruppo di individui vestiti allo stesso modo, che supponi essere anche loro studiosi.

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	"Captain! I delight to see thy return; I came here with haste as soon as I saw that thou was to arrive!"|35|0
units.english: "Captain! I delight to see thy return; I came here with haste as soon as I saw that thou was to arrive!"
units.italian: "Capitano! Gioisco nel vederti tornare; sono venuto qui in fretta appena ho visto che stavi per arrivare!"

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	You greet Sieasej, and they explain that the scholars with them are researchers of the Predecessors seeking transport on a wormhole-traveling vessel.|36|0
units.english: You greet Sieasej, and they explain that the scholars with them are researchers of the Predecessors seeking transport on a wormhole-traveling vessel.
units.italian: Saluti Sieasej, e ti spiegano che gli studiosi con loro sono ricercatori dei Predecessori in cerca di un passaggio su una nave che attraversi i wormhole.

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	"The ship modifications necessary are woefully expensive," one of the researchers continues. "Were we to petition Sioeora and the Academy to offer us a properly-equipped vessel, we might be forced to wait for years, a pace that's far too slow for our research. If thou were't to transport us instead, even for a short time, it would advance our study greatly."|37|0
units.english: "The ship modifications necessary are woefully expensive," one of the researchers continues. "Were we to petition Sioeora and the Academy to offer us a properly-equipped vessel, we might be forced to wait for years, a pace that's far too slow for our research. If thou were't to transport us instead, even for a short time, it would advance our study greatly."
units.italian: "Le modifiche necessarie alla nave sono deplorevolmente costose," continua uno dei ricercatori. "Se dovessimo chiedere a Sioeora e all'Accademia una nave attrezzata come si deve, potremmo essere costretti ad aspettare anni, un ritmo fin troppo lento per la nostra ricerca. Se invece ci trasportassi tu, anche per poco tempo, faresti progredire molto il nostro studio."

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	"Sure, I would be happy to."|39|0
units.english: "Sure, I would be happy to."
units.italian: "Certo, ne sarei felice."

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	"Can I come back another time?"|41|0
units.english: "Can I come back another time?"
units.italian: "Posso tornare un'altra volta?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	"Sorry, but you'll have to find someone else to take you."|43|0
units.english: "Sorry, but you'll have to find someone else to take you."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma dovrai trovare qualcun altro che vi porti."

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	"Hm, probably. We've been patient enough for this long, though I encourage thee to seek us out again with haste."|48|0
units.english: "Hm, probably. We've been patient enough for this long, though I encourage thee to seek us out again with haste."
units.italian: "Hm, probabilmente. Siamo stati pazienti abbastanza a lungo, ma ti esorto a cercarci di nuovo in fretta."

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	"Our deepest thanks!" Several of the members of the research team smile conspiratorially, clearly excited to be skipping the queue. Sieasej also offers their thanks and makes clear that they'll "keep an eye out for any more interesting opportunities."|51|0
units.english: "Our deepest thanks!" Several of the members of the research team smile conspiratorially, clearly excited to be skipping the queue. Sieasej also offers their thanks and makes clear that they'll "keep an eye out for any more interesting opportunities."
units.italian: "La nostra più profonda gratitudine!" Diversi membri del gruppo di ricerca sorridono in modo complice, chiaramente entusiasti di saltare la fila. Anche Sieasej ti ringrazia e ti fa capire che terrà "gli occhi aperti per altre occasioni interessanti".

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|label|53|0
units.english: has deferred
units.italian: has deferred

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	You realize that the Predecessor research team from House Sioeora is probably still waiting to see if you can transport them to <planet stopovers>. Would you like to contact them?|54|0
units.english: You realize that the Predecessor research team from House Sioeora is probably still waiting to see if you can transport them to <planet stopovers>. Would you like to contact them?
units.italian: Ti rendi conto che il gruppo di ricerca sui Predecessori di Casa Sioeora sta probabilmente ancora aspettando di sapere se puoi trasportarli su <planet stopovers>. Vuoi contattarli?

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	(Yes.)|56|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	(Not now.)|57|0
units.english: (Not now.)
units.italian: (Non ora.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	(Never.)|59|0
units.english: (Never.)
units.italian: (Mai.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	You manage to get in contact with the head of the research group, who is quite excited to hear that you finally have the opportunity to transport them and their team. After about an hour of waiting in the spaceport, the researchers arrive to meet you, and you eventually manage to get them loaded onto your ship and ready for departure.|61|0
units.english: You manage to get in contact with the head of the research group, who is quite excited to hear that you finally have the opportunity to transport them and their team. After about an hour of waiting in the spaceport, the researchers arrive to meet you, and you eventually manage to get them loaded onto your ship and ready for departure.
units.italian: Riesci a metterti in contatto con il capo del gruppo di ricerca, che è molto entusiasta di sapere che hai finalmente l'occasione di trasportare loro e il loro gruppo. Dopo circa un'ora di attesa nello spazioporto, i ricercatori arrivano a incontrarti e alla fine riesci a farli salire sulla nave, pronti a partire.

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|While relatively calm and subdued during the journey here, the researchers bolt out of the airlock almost the instant your ship's landing gear touch the ground, their arms loaded down with an innumerable array of booklets, catalogs, and strange devices that they waste no time in thrusting into the air or towards the rocks and soil.|65|0
units.english: While relatively calm and subdued during the journey here, the researchers bolt out of the airlock almost the instant your ship's landing gear touch the ground, their arms loaded down with an innumerable array of booklets, catalogs, and strange devices that they waste no time in thrusting into the air or towards the rocks and soil.
units.italian: Relativamente calmi e composti durante il viaggio di andata, i ricercatori schizzano fuori dal portello quasi nell'istante in cui il carrello della nave tocca terra, con le braccia cariche di una miriade di opuscoli, cataloghi e strani congegni che non perdono tempo a sollevare in aria o a spingere verso rocce e terreno.

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	As night begins to fall on the planet, the researchers reluctantly return to your ship, dusty and tired but abuzz with excitement at their discoveries.|66|0
units.english: As night begins to fall on the planet, the researchers reluctantly return to your ship, dusty and tired but abuzz with excitement at their discoveries.
units.italian: Mentre sul pianeta comincia a scendere la notte, i ricercatori tornano di malavoglia alla nave, impolverati e stanchi ma in fermento per le loro scoperte.

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	As you are making preparations to leave, you realize this would be a good moment to learn about the Predecessors from the experts, especially considering you're liable to be listening to them talk about their new data all the way back.|67|0
units.english: As you are making preparations to leave, you realize this would be a good moment to learn about the Predecessors from the experts, especially considering you're liable to be listening to them talk about their new data all the way back.
units.italian: Mentre ti prepari a partire, ti rendi conto che sarebbe un buon momento per sapere qualcosa sui Predecessori dagli esperti, soprattutto considerando che probabilmente li ascolterai parlare dei loro nuovi dati per tutto il viaggio di ritorno.

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	"What can you tell me about the Predecessors?"|69|0
units.english: "What can you tell me about the Predecessors?"
units.italian: "Che cosa puoi dirmi dei Predecessori?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	(Don't ask them anything.)|71|0
units.english: (Don't ask them anything.)
units.italian: (Non chiedere loro nulla.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	"Who were the Predecessors?"|75|0
units.english: "Who were the Predecessors?"
units.italian: "Chi erano i Predecessori?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	"Actually, I didn't have any questions after all."|78|0
units.english: "Actually, I didn't have any questions after all."
units.italian: "In realtà, non avevo domande, alla fine."

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	"What caused the collapse?"|82|0
units.english: "What caused the collapse?"
units.italian: "Che cosa ha causato il crollo?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	"How large was their empire?"|87|0
units.english: "How large was their empire?"
units.italian: "Quanto era grande il loro impero?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	"What was their technology like?"|92|0
units.english: "What was their technology like?"
units.italian: "Com'era la loro tecnologia?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	"I have no more questions."|97|0
units.english: "I have no more questions."
units.italian: "Non ho altre domande."

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	"Our Predecessors were our now-gone ancestors. Until the time of fifteen hundred years ago, they ruled this space and much beyond as part of their own empire. Many perished along with their bloodlines as much of the empire fell to ruin, but some made passage through the wormhole to the cluster that we, as their Successors, now call our home."|104|0
units.english: "Our Predecessors were our now-gone ancestors. Until the time of fifteen hundred years ago, they ruled this space and much beyond as part of their own empire. Many perished along with their bloodlines as much of the empire fell to ruin, but some made passage through the wormhole to the cluster that we, as their Successors, now call our home."
units.italian: "I nostri Predecessori erano i nostri antenati ormai scomparsi. Fino a millecinquecento anni fa dominavano questo spazio e molto altro come parte del loro impero. Molti perirono insieme alle loro discendenze quando gran parte dell'impero cadde in rovina, ma alcuni passarono attraverso il wormhole fino all'ammasso che noi, loro Successori, chiamiamo ora casa."

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	The researcher sighs. "We do not know; or better put, the fullness of the truth yet remains obscured. The flesh of space itself was rent, distorted; the effects of this remain today: the holes embedded in the skies, the dying-out of light and even of the hyperlanes. It was a warring time; the Houses turned upon each other or they fled, and space itself was set alight with the blinks of shots and drives..."|109|0
units.english: The researcher sighs. "We do not know; or better put, the fullness of the truth yet remains obscured. The flesh of space itself was rent, distorted; the effects of this remain today: the holes embedded in the skies, the dying-out of light and even of the hyperlanes. It was a warring time; the Houses turned upon each other or they fled, and space itself was set alight with the blinks of shots and drives..."
units.italian: Il ricercatore sospira. "Non lo sappiamo; o meglio, la pienezza della verità resta ancora oscurata. La carne dello spazio stesso fu lacerata, distorta; gli effetti rimangono oggi: i buchi incastonati nei cieli, lo spegnersi della luce e perfino delle ipervie. Fu un tempo di guerre; le Casate si rivoltarono l'una contro l'altra o fuggirono, e lo spazio stesso fu acceso dai lampi degli spari e dei motori..."

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	The researcher stops for a moment, composing themself.|110|0
units.english: The researcher stops for a moment, composing themself.
units.italian: Il ricercatore si ferma un momento, ricomponendosi.

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	"I digress and do apologize. 'Tis challenging to separate the truth from fiction in this regard. Our Predecessors wielded power far beyond our modern imitations, the sort that sows the seeds of peace or chaos deep within the fabric of the world, the sort of things that poke and prod at places that must remain untouched. 'What caused the collapse?' you ask? Hubris, methinks."|111|0
units.english: "I digress and do apologize. 'Tis challenging to separate the truth from fiction in this regard. Our Predecessors wielded power far beyond our modern imitations, the sort that sows the seeds of peace or chaos deep within the fabric of the world, the sort of things that poke and prod at places that must remain untouched. 'What caused the collapse?' you ask? Hubris, methinks."
units.italian: "Divago e mi scuso. È difficile separare la verità dalla finzione, in questo. I nostri Predecessori esercitavano un potere molto oltre le nostre imitazioni moderne, di quella specie che semina pace o caos in fondo al tessuto del mondo, di quella specie che fruga e punge in luoghi che devono restare intatti. 'Che cosa ha causato il crollo?' chiedi? Tracotanza, direi."

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	"The translation device thou wears upon thy person speaks volumes to its scale. Sieasej tells me that at the empire's peak, our scholars had even laid eyes upon thine own world, so far to the north! These dead systems that remain where once the core of their empire stood are but a small fraction of what was there. Some, it's sure, now belong to other races, and others, it would seem, have been obscured. We know not how nor why, only that the starcharts of our Predecessors do not mirror those we see today."|116|0
units.english: "The translation device thou wears upon thy person speaks volumes to its scale. Sieasej tells me that at the empire's peak, our scholars had even laid eyes upon thine own world, so far to the north! These dead systems that remain where once the core of their empire stood are but a small fraction of what was there. Some, it's sure, now belong to other races, and others, it would seem, have been obscured. We know not how nor why, only that the starcharts of our Predecessors do not mirror those we see today."
units.italian: "Il dispositivo di traduzione che porti addosso dice molto delle loro dimensioni. Sieasej mi dice che al culmine dell'impero i nostri studiosi avevano perfino posato gli occhi sul tuo mondo, così lontano a nord! Questi sistemi morti che restano dove un tempo sorgeva il cuore del loro impero sono solo una piccola frazione di ciò che c'era. Alcuni, è certo, appartengono ora ad altre specie, e altri, a quanto pare, sono stati oscurati. Non sappiamo come né perché, solo che le mappe stellari dei nostri Predecessori non rispecchiano quelle che vediamo oggi."

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	"Glorious and beautiful, it was; as much a sort of art as of engineering. Our Predecessors' works were envied even by the Quarg, whose mastery of art and science only few may equal. T'were exotic in their natures and unique in applications; living metal grown in stars, subtle points to pierce space itself. We have descriptions, enough to make rudimentary imitations of their processes, but even if we had a perfect understanding of wha'twas, the space of our new systems seems unsuitable to manifest that mastery. We fail even to replicate the heirlooms kept by the High Houses; the materials and techniques they use are always out of reach."|121|0
units.english: "Glorious and beautiful, it was; as much a sort of art as of engineering. Our Predecessors' works were envied even by the Quarg, whose mastery of art and science only few may equal. T'were exotic in their natures and unique in applications; living metal grown in stars, subtle points to pierce space itself. We have descriptions, enough to make rudimentary imitations of their processes, but even if we had a perfect understanding of wha'twas, the space of our new systems seems unsuitable to manifest that mastery. We fail even to replicate the heirlooms kept by the High Houses; the materials and techniques they use are always out of reach."
units.italian: "Gloriosa e bella, era; tanto arte quanto ingegneria. Le opere dei nostri Predecessori erano invidiate perfino dai Quarg, la cui padronanza di arte e scienza pochi possono eguagliare. Erano esotiche per natura e uniche nelle applicazioni: metallo vivo coltivato nelle stelle, punti sottili per trapassare lo spazio stesso. Abbiamo descrizioni, abbastanza per fare imitazioni rudimentali dei loro processi, ma anche con una comprensione perfetta di ciò che erano, lo spazio dei nostri nuovi sistemi sembra inadatto a manifestare quella padronanza. Falliamo perfino nel replicare i cimeli conservati dalle Alte Casate; i materiali e le tecniche che usano restano sempre fuori portata."

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	You leave the researchers to study their findings.|124|0
units.english: You leave the researchers to study their findings.
units.italian: Lasci i ricercatori a studiare i loro risultati.

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|As expected, the scholars remained highly conversational on the way back, remarking on unusual radiation measurements and fawning over several small metal fragments collected by one particularly lucky member of the team.|135|0
units.english: As expected, the scholars remained highly conversational on the way back, remarking on unusual radiation measurements and fawning over several small metal fragments collected by one particularly lucky member of the team.
units.italian: Come previsto, gli studiosi sono rimasti molto loquaci durante il viaggio di ritorno, commentando insolite misurazioni di radiazioni e facendo festa a diversi piccoli frammenti metallici raccolti da un membro del gruppo particolarmente fortunato.

units.id: mission:Successors: Predecessor Research 1|	They almost forget to give you your payment when you return them to <destination>, but the head researcher places a chip for <payment> into your hands and thanks you before departing into the spaceport.|136|0
units.english: They almost forget to give you your payment when you return them to <destination>, but the head researcher places a chip for <payment> into your hands and thanks you before departing into the spaceport.
units.italian: Quasi dimenticano di darti il pagamento quando li riporti a <destination>, ma il capo ricercatore ti mette in mano un chip da <payment> e ti ringrazia prima di addentrarsi nello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|name|140|0
units.english: Assist Predecessor Biologist
units.italian: Assisti il biologo dei Predecessori

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|description|141|0
units.english: Transport a Successor biologist to <stopovers> and then home to <destination> by <date>.
units.italian: Trasporta un biologo Successore fino a <stopovers> e poi a casa, su <destination>, entro il <date>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|While you are sitting in the spaceport, you are approached by a Successor wearing a curious green outfit and carrying several pieces of seemingly high-tech equipment, enough that it appears close to falling out of their arms. They explain that they are a Successor biologist who had chartered a flight to go and examine the primordial life on <planet stopovers>, a young and still-developing planet, but that their pilot had been detained, leaving them stranded here.|155|0
units.english: While you are sitting in the spaceport, you are approached by a Successor wearing a curious green outfit and carrying several pieces of seemingly high-tech equipment, enough that it appears close to falling out of their arms. They explain that they are a Successor biologist who had chartered a flight to go and examine the primordial life on <planet stopovers>, a young and still-developing planet, but that their pilot had been detained, leaving them stranded here.
units.italian: Mentre sei seduto nello spazioporto, ti si avvicina un Successore con un curioso abito verde, che porta diversi pezzi di attrezzatura apparentemente sofisticata, tanti da sembrare sul punto di cadergli dalle braccia. Ti spiegano che sono un biologo Successore che aveva noleggiato un volo per andare a esaminare la vita primordiale su <planet stopovers>, un pianeta giovane e ancora in formazione, ma che il loro pilota è stato trattenuto, lasciandoli bloccati qui.

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	"If thou coulds't provide travel to that planet, I may still be able to gather my data before my period of research leave expires."|156|0
units.english: "If thou coulds't provide travel to that planet, I may still be able to gather my data before my period of research leave expires."
units.italian: "Se potessi fornire un passaggio fino a quel pianeta, potrei ancora raccogliere i miei dati prima che scada il mio congedo di ricerca."

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	"Sure, I would be happy to."|158|0
units.english: "Sure, I would be happy to."
units.italian: "Certo, ne sarei felice."

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	"Sorry, but you'll have to find someone else to take you."|160|0
units.english: "Sorry, but you'll have to find someone else to take you."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma dovrai trovare qualcun altro che vi porti."

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	"Thou has my deep and certain thanks. Tell none, but the High Houses are beastly to us academics." The biologist, who introduces themselves as "Kaatiora," loads their collection of equipment into your ship - though not without almost dropping one particularly fragile-looking item - and is eventually ready to leave.|163|0
units.english: "Thou has my deep and certain thanks. Tell none, but the High Houses are beastly to us academics." The biologist, who introduces themselves as "Kaatiora," loads their collection of equipment into your ship - though not without almost dropping one particularly fragile-looking item - and is eventually ready to leave.
units.italian: "Hai la mia profonda e certa gratitudine. Non dirlo a nessuno, ma le Alte Casate sono bestiali con noi accademici." Il biologo, che si presenta come "Kaatiora", carica la loro collezione di attrezzature sulla tua nave, non senza quasi far cadere un oggetto dall'aria particolarmente fragile, e alla fine è pronto a partire.

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|On the way here, Kaatiora has been impressively inquisitive, continually asking you questions about human biology with a level of verve and excitement you had previously thought impossible. Once they exhausted your knowledge of every detail of human biology, they moved on without hesitation to every other Earth-related species they knew of from Predecessor records, from cattle to frogs to far more exotic ones that you've never heard of in your life but apparently are all the rage among the circles of Successor xenobiology.|167|0
units.english: On the way here, Kaatiora has been impressively inquisitive, continually asking you questions about human biology with a level of verve and excitement you had previously thought impossible. Once they exhausted your knowledge of every detail of human biology, they moved on without hesitation to every other Earth-related species they knew of from Predecessor records, from cattle to frogs to far more exotic ones that you've never heard of in your life but apparently are all the rage among the circles of Successor xenobiology.
units.italian: Durante il viaggio Kaatiora è stato di una curiosità impressionante, facendoti continuamente domande sulla biologia umana con un entusiasmo e un brio che prima avresti creduto impossibili. Esaurita la tua conoscenza di ogni dettaglio della biologia umana, sono passati senza esitazione a ogni altra specie terrestre che conoscevano dai documenti dei Predecessori, dalle mucche alle rane fino ad altre molto più esotiche di cui non hai mai sentito parlare ma che evidentemente vanno di moda nei circoli di xenobiologia dei Successori.

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	It is somewhat relieving when you finally arrive at the planet and Kaatiora momentarily departs, once again carrying their more-than-armful of equipment and excitedly but carefully scanning the volcanic hot-water pools and small lakes around your landing site, occasionally exclaiming with excitement.|168|0
units.english: It is somewhat relieving when you finally arrive at the planet and Kaatiora momentarily departs, once again carrying their more-than-armful of equipment and excitedly but carefully scanning the volcanic hot-water pools and small lakes around your landing site, occasionally exclaiming with excitement.
units.italian: È un certo sollievo quando arrivate finalmente sul pianeta e Kaatiora si allontana per un momento, portando ancora una volta le braccia stracolme di attrezzatura e scansionando con eccitazione ma con cura le pozze di acqua calda vulcanica e i piccoli laghi intorno al punto di atterraggio, esclamando di tanto in tanto per l'entusiasmo.

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	Eventually they return to your ship, satisfied with the amount of data they have collected, but still obviously energized by the experience.|169|0
units.english: Eventually they return to your ship, satisfied with the amount of data they have collected, but still obviously energized by the experience.
units.italian: Alla fine tornano alla tua nave, soddisfatti della quantità di dati raccolti, ma ancora evidentemente carichi dell'esperienza.

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	Before leaving, you realize this would be a good time to learn more about the Successors from an expert. Besides, since you spent the majority of the time on the way here answering Kaatiora's questions, you are probably entitled to ask a few of your own.|170|0
units.english: Before leaving, you realize this would be a good time to learn more about the Successors from an expert. Besides, since you spent the majority of the time on the way here answering Kaatiora's questions, you are probably entitled to ask a few of your own.
units.italian: Prima di partire, ti rendi conto che sarebbe un buon momento per saperne di più sui Successori da un esperto. Del resto, avendo passato la maggior parte del viaggio di andata a rispondere alle domande di Kaatiora, hai probabilmente diritto a farne qualcuna tua.

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	(Ask about Successor biology.)|172|0
units.english: (Ask about Successor biology.)
units.italian: (Chiedi della biologia dei Successori.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	(Don't ask anything.)|173|0
units.english: (Don't ask anything.)
units.italian: (Non chiedere nulla.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	As expected, Kaatiora is more than happy to share their biological knowledge, and asks if there is anything in particular you'd like to know about.|175|0
units.english: As expected, Kaatiora is more than happy to share their biological knowledge, and asks if there is anything in particular you'd like to know about.
units.italian: Come previsto, Kaatiora è più che felice di condividere le proprie conoscenze biologiche, e chiede se c'è qualcosa in particolare che vorresti sapere.

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	"What can you tell me about the Successors?"|178|0
units.english: "What can you tell me about the Successors?"
units.italian: "Che cosa puoi dirmi dei Successori?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	"Were the Predecessors any different from the present Successors, biologically speaking?"|182|0
units.english: "Were the Predecessors any different from the present Successors, biologically speaking?"
units.italian: "I Predecessori erano diversi dagli attuali Successori, biologicamente parlando?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	"What is the life in this star cluster like?"|186|0
units.english: "What is the life in this star cluster like?"
units.italian: "Com'è la vita in questo ammasso stellare?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	"I have no more questions."|190|0
units.english: "I have no more questions."
units.italian: "Non ho altre domande."

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	"Much of our evolutionary history, we spent beneath the waves of our home planet, and while now you clearly see we breathe the same air as you, we still retain our cold and water-loving tendencies. Our respiration works just as well submerged as on dry land, though we must retain some degree of moisture on our skin.|195|0
units.english: "Much of our evolutionary history, we spent beneath the waves of our home planet, and while now you clearly see we breathe the same air as you, we still retain our cold and water-loving tendencies. Our respiration works just as well submerged as on dry land, though we must retain some degree of moisture on our skin.
units.italian: "Gran parte della nostra storia evolutiva l'abbiamo passata sotto le onde del nostro pianeta natale, e anche se ora vedi chiaramente che respiriamo la stessa aria che respiri tu, conserviamo ancora le nostre tendenze fredde e amanti dell'acqua. La nostra respirazione funziona bene sia sommersa sia sulla terraferma, anche se dobbiamo mantenere un certo grado di umidità sulla pelle.

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	"Apart from that, we are a hermaphroditic species, like most from our home planet, and as we took to the stars, we learned that this is uncommon but not rare, and so there is some curiosity as to why our planet had such a diversity of such species while most do not. Perhaps, since we grew up under a harsh sun, the redundancy provided by our divorce from biological sex was beneficial to our evolution.|196|0
units.english: "Apart from that, we are a hermaphroditic species, like most from our home planet, and as we took to the stars, we learned that this is uncommon but not rare, and so there is some curiosity as to why our planet had such a diversity of such species while most do not. Perhaps, since we grew up under a harsh sun, the redundancy provided by our divorce from biological sex was beneficial to our evolution.
units.italian: "A parte questo, siamo una specie ermafrodita, come la maggior parte di quelle del nostro pianeta natale, e quando siamo andati fra le stelle abbiamo scoperto che questo è insolito ma non raro, e c'è quindi una certa curiosità sul perché il nostro pianeta avesse una tale diversità di specie simili mentre la maggior parte non ce l'ha. Forse, essendo cresciuti sotto un sole aspro, la ridondanza offerta dal nostro divorzio dal sesso biologico è stata vantaggiosa per la nostra evoluzione.

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	"And of course, thou hast surely noticed by now the natural camouflage of our skin. While today its use is for communication, it was long ago a useful tool for evading predators who hunted by sight, until, of course, we gained the wisdom to outsmart our predators rather than hide from them."|197|0
units.english: "And of course, thou hast surely noticed by now the natural camouflage of our skin. While today its use is for communication, it was long ago a useful tool for evading predators who hunted by sight, until, of course, we gained the wisdom to outsmart our predators rather than hide from them."
units.italian: "E naturalmente, a quest'ora avrai notato il camuffamento naturale della nostra pelle. Oggi il suo uso è la comunicazione, ma molto tempo fa era uno strumento utile per sfuggire ai predatori che cacciavano a vista, finché, naturalmente, non abbiamo acquisito la saggezza di superare in astuzia i nostri predatori invece di nasconderci da loro."

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	"As brevity is the soul of wit, then no, our Predecessors did not differ greatly from us in their core biology. A scion of the High Houses from the time of the collapse would not stand out from the average one of us in the present day. That being said, their understanding of it was much superior: their medical science was much more advanced than our own, and much of their technology was genetically coded to function only for specific families."|202|0
units.english: "As brevity is the soul of wit, then no, our Predecessors did not differ greatly from us in their core biology. A scion of the High Houses from the time of the collapse would not stand out from the average one of us in the present day. That being said, their understanding of it was much superior: their medical science was much more advanced than our own, and much of their technology was genetically coded to function only for specific families."
units.italian: "Dato che la brevità è l'anima dell'arguzia, allora no: i nostri Predecessori non differivano molto da noi nella biologia di fondo. Un erede delle Alte Casate dei tempi del crollo non si distinguerebbe da uno qualunque di noi oggi. Detto questo, la loro comprensione era molto superiore: la loro scienza medica era molto più avanzata della nostra, e gran parte della loro tecnologia era codificata geneticamente per funzionare solo per famiglie specifiche."

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	"Thou asks at a fortuitous time! This planet, and the life that lives upon it, may provide to us a better answer to that question. Many of the stars here are hot and young and therefore harsh to nascent life, and yet thou hast surely seen the verdant worlds that orbit them! While some of this results from early settlement during the old empire, much of it does not and therefore remains a vexing point. How could life develop here? If we can track the path taken by the life of this planet, we may find the answer both you and I seek."|207|0
units.english: "Thou asks at a fortuitous time! This planet, and the life that lives upon it, may provide to us a better answer to that question. Many of the stars here are hot and young and therefore harsh to nascent life, and yet thou hast surely seen the verdant worlds that orbit them! While some of this results from early settlement during the old empire, much of it does not and therefore remains a vexing point. How could life develop here? If we can track the path taken by the life of this planet, we may find the answer both you and I seek."
units.italian: "Chiedi al momento giusto! Questo pianeta, e la vita che vi abita, potrebbero darci una risposta migliore a quella domanda. Molte delle stelle qui sono calde e giovani, e quindi aspre per la vita nascente, eppure hai certamente visto i mondi verdissimi che le orbitano! Se parte di questo deriva dagli insediamenti dei primi tempi dell'antico impero, molto non ne deriva, e resta quindi un punto fastidioso. Come può essersi sviluppata la vita, qui? Se riusciamo a tracciare il percorso seguito dalla vita di questo pianeta, potremmo trovare la risposta che cerchiamo entrambi."

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	You leave Katiiora to their business and make your preparations to take off when ready.|210|0
units.english: You leave Katiiora to their business and make your preparations to take off when ready.
units.italian: Lasci Kaatiora alle loro faccende e ti prepari a decollare quando sei pronto.

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	Kaatiora remains excited and talkative on the way back, though marginally less so now that they have exhausted the totality of your knowledge of the biological sciences and have the analysis of their recently-gathered data to occupy them.|219|0
units.english: Kaatiora remains excited and talkative on the way back, though marginally less so now that they have exhausted the totality of your knowledge of the biological sciences and have the analysis of their recently-gathered data to occupy them.
units.italian: Kaatiora resta entusiasta e loquace durante il viaggio di ritorno, anche se un po' meno ora che ha esaurito la totalità delle tue conoscenze delle scienze biologiche e ha l'analisi dei dati appena raccolti a tenerlo occupato.

units.id: mission:Successors: Biology Research 1|	Upon landing at <destination>, they disembark from your ship, once again carrying their excess of equipment, but not before giving you your payment of <payment> and once again offering their thanks for transporting them.|220|0
units.english: Upon landing at <destination>, they disembark from your ship, once again carrying their excess of equipment, but not before giving you your payment of <payment> and once again offering their thanks for transporting them.
units.italian: All'atterraggio su <destination>, scendono dalla nave, portando ancora una volta l'eccesso di attrezzatura, ma non prima di darti il pagamento di <payment> e di ringraziarti di nuovo per il trasporto.
